title: Slapsgiving 3: Slappointment in Slapmarra
cn: 第 14 集 · 第三次拍脸节
novel:
Marshall [[explained|explain]] to the gang how he had [[mastered|master]] the Slap of a Million Exploding Suns. He told them a [[legendary|legendary]] story about his journey to a [[distant|distant]] temple in Shanghai.

According to Marshall's tale, he had [[traveled|travel]] to Shanghai to learn an [[ancient|ancient]] [[martial|martial]] art from three masters. Each master taught him a different skill. The training was intense and tested his limits. He had to [[strike|strike]] a target thousands of times until his hands were numb. The masters never allowed him to rest.

Marshall [[described|describe]] how he had to [[train|train]] for weeks under each master. Robin and Barney listened with growing [[anxiety|anxiety]] because they knew Marshall was building up to the final slap. Barney tried to [[escape|escape]] but Marshall reminded him of the slap [[bet|bet]] they had made years ago.

Marshall [[revealed|reveal]] that the third master had given him a special [[technique|technique]] that would make the slap incredibly [[powerful|powerful]]. He called it the Slap of a Million Exploding Suns. The gang was both impressed and terrified.

In reality, Marshall had just watched a lot of kung fu movies and made the whole story up. But he told it with such enthusiasm that everyone believed him, at least for a moment. The episode ended with Marshall [[preparing|prepare]] for the final slap, as Barney [[trembled|tremble]] with fear.
